title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: ‘condemns any attempts to use food insecurity as a weapon or tool of coercion; calls for continued diplomatic and practical efforts to safeguard maritime trade routes, reduce risks for commercial shipping and ensure that disruptions to essential supplies do not disproportionately affect vulnerable populations and import-dependent countries; calls on the Commission to assess measures to mitigate the effects of war-risk costs on EU operators and ports, to support seafarers’ welfare, and to maintain and strengthen export routes, including the EU-Ukraine Solidarity Lanes, in order to safeguard food security; stresses that maintaining Ukraine’s export capacity is essential to its economic resilience and ability to finance its defence against Russian aggression;’
